column1: # p476 version-election reader, 2026-10-27. Built to answer Gap 475-A, which established that the
# licence PAYLOAD cannot reveal a GPL-family version election ("any later version" is stock boilerplate,
# 3 of 3 payloads) and named two places the election actually lives: packaging metadata and per-source-file
# notices. This reader looks in both. Every file was fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at the
# ls-remote-resolved HEAD, written to disk, and the FILE measured (Gap 468-A).
# channel_meta  = licence/SPDX field in packaging metadata, verbatim; NO_FIELD = file fetched, no licence key.
# channel_src   = per-source-file notice; counted multi-line-aware (the FSF notice wraps across lines).
# --- non-GPL controls: method must not manufacture signal where the grant is already unambiguous ---
